subtitle: Wildlife response to wind energy development in industrial forests -- Chowan County, North Carolina
investigator: Will Harrod, PhD student, NC State University
disclaimer: PRELIMINARY DATA -- annotation and validation are in progress. Bucket-camera identifications are complete; acoustic bird detections are filtered to validated per-species cutoffs, and anuran detections are not validated at all. Counts are provisional. Do not cite, redistribute, or draw ecological conclusions from these figures.

views.label: Bat Audio
views.pending_note: 26,268 ultrasonic recordings were collected at 50 locations for 14-55 nights each. Classification with Kaleidoscope Pro has not yet begun.

views.label: Vegetation
views.pending_note: Wiens-pole understory measurements (41 points per sensor location) and 360-degree canopy photographs were collected June-July 2026 and are being digitized.

annotation_progress.note: Sequences are the Wildlife Insights identification unit. The export's AHDriFT rows are no longer used for the bucket-camera view: those identifications are superseded by the cleaned AHDriFT table, which also records the plot-days that produced no detection.

ahdrift.label: Bucket cameras (AHDriFT)
stats: 76% of reviewed plot-days, recorded explicitly as zeroes
ahdrift.note: Motion-capture identification is complete for the 2026 season. Because plot-days with no detection are recorded rather than left out, survey effort, detection rate and naive occupancy are all computable from this one table.

parallel.label: Parallel cameras
stats: of 9159 in the export (100.0%), by 7 reviewers
1333 more stop at a coarse or non-wildlife label
parallel.note: The AHDriFT rows in the same export (4945 sequences) are no longer used anywhere on this dashboard; the cleaned bucket-camera table supersedes them.

birdnet.label: Bird and frog audio (BirdNET)
stats: 66.0% of the 2637897 raw detections of those species
11 anurans, 12 birds in the queue, 5 birds with no attainable cutoff
birdnet.note: For each species, 150 detections were reviewed by ear and the lowest confidence at which 95% of detections were true positives was recorded as that species' cutoff. The dashboard applies each cutoff to its own species. Five species never reached 95% at any confidence and carry a nominal 1.0 instead of a usable cutoff; anurans and the remaining birds have not been reviewed yet and are shown unfiltered.

data_gaps.detail: ARU plot IF10 has 7 recording days in the BirdNET output (2026-03-02 to 2026-03-08) but no entry in the location table, so it cannot be mapped.
2 parallel-camera station(s) (IF09-CT01, TE02-CT04) have Wildlife Insights deployments but no row in cam_trap_locations_info.csv, so they contribute effort and detections but no marker.

1 species (Swainson's Warbler) carry a threshold decision in BirdNet_Thresholds.csv but no Positive/Negative/Skipped counts, so the clips behind that decision are not recorded. The detection filtering is unaffected; only the reported listening effort is.
1 reptile/amphibian taxon(s) in the cleaned AHDriFT table have no photograph in the album: Tree Frog Species.
